category_definitions.integration: A real project service/API/network/process/store/runtime boundary materially supports the asserted observable behavior, including direct production readback of no effect. Setup alone is insufficient.
category_definitions.unit: Local predicates, supplied stubs/writers, arithmetic, validation or in-process context/timer logic; incidental service/filesystem setup is insufficient.
category_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent unit-only assertion blocks accompany meaningful real-boundary assertions.
category_definitions.unresolved: Source or mapping is missing/ambiguous, or contradiction prevents establishing a category; source blockers remain uncredited even when earlier assertions support another category.
